ruling.recommended_action: Issue a Ryde voucher of S$7.29 to the rider for the unexempted second detour (Woodlands Centre Rd → Woodlands Ave 3 loop), computed as 5.17 extra km × S$1.41/km metered rate; no account flag (driver's 90-day route-dispute record is clean).

segment_findings.reason: Initial ≈3.3 km detour via Kranji Rd / Woodlands Ave 3 was the jam bypass the rider agreed to (chat + rider's own complaint 'I agreed to go round the jam near the start'); driver's 18:37:30 request named the Kranji Expressway, matching this area. RD-5/RD-3 apply.

≈5.2 km out-and-back loop via Woodlands Centre Rd (19:00–19:07) not on the optimal BKE/PIE corridor. No traffic incident matched (RD-4(a) fails) and band data alone cannot exempt (RD-4(b)); driver's request at 18:37:30 was after the detour began and covered only Kranji Expressway, so no rider consent (RD-5). Driver's statement concedes it was his own GPS rerouting. Un-exempted under RD-1 → RD-2 refund.
